senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָמַר II)to be thick, tufty.—Denom. עָמִיר.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:5">Ukts. II, 5</cite> <he>והבצלים שעֲמָרָן</he>, Var. for <he>שחמרן</he>.—Denom. <cite ref="P00288"><he>עוֹמֶר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of עוֹמֶר) to bind and pile sheaves; to harvest.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:8">Peah V, 8</cite> <he>המְעַמֵּר וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00195"><he>כּוֹבְעָה</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="H01775"><he>חֲרָרָה</he></cite>. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ top <he>חרש זרע … קצר עי׳ וכ׳</he> he ploughed, he sowed …, he cut, piled up, threshed &c.; Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite>. Y. Peah IV, 18ᵈ bot. <he>בקוצר שורה ומעמר שורה</he> when he cuts a row and puts it up in sheaves at a time; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) (with ב) to make one’s self the master of; to make use of a person as a servant.
units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:7">Deut. XXIV, 7</cite>) <he>אינו חייב עד שיכניסנו לרשותו</he> he is not guilty of abduction, unless he brought the person to his own grounds; (oth. opin.) <he>עד … וישתמש בו</he> unless he brought the person to his own grounds and made use of him; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 273">Sifré Deut. 273</cite>.
